title: Represent SRD monster and stat-block interpretation rules
description:
Problem
The importer emits creature stat blocks, but the SRD rules that explain how to interpret monster/stat-block fields are not adequately represented.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Unrepresented or underrepresented content around pages 254-260 includes:
- Monster size, type, and tags
- Alignment, armor class, hit points, speed
- Ability scores, saving throws, skills, vulnerabilities, resistances, immunities
- Senses, languages, challenge, and XP by CR
- Special traits, actions, reactions, limited usage
- Legendary creatures, lairs, and regional effects
- Tables such as XP by challenge rating

Required behavior
- Import stat-block interpretation rules as rule and/or table records.
- Do not rely on creature records alone to explain the meaning of creature fields.
- Preserve table structure for XP by CR and related monster rules tables.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
close_reason: PR #190 open — 44 monster stat-block interpretation rules + 4 monster reference tables added (rule 206→250, table 19→23); caption-exclusion now keeps resuming section prose (recovers ability-checks/ability-scores-and-modifiers/speed); follow-up eshyra-10t filed for Travel Pace + Ability Scores and Modifiers tables; all tests passing
